en.headline: John Lee begins Beijing visit, meets municipal leaders on Northern Metropolis
en.dek: Chief Executive tours the Beijing Municipal Administrative Center and meets Yin Li and Yin Yong to discuss co-operation under the 15th Five-Year Plan.
body: Chief Executive John Lee began his visit to Beijing on Tuesday by touring the Beijing Municipal Administrative Center and meeting senior municipal officials.

In the afternoon Lee visited the Beijing Library, one of the center’s three major cultural facilities, and the planning exhibition hall at the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee building. He examined a sand-table model of the overall plan and cultural facilities.

Lee said the center, one of Beijing’s new “two wings” in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei co-ordinated development, offered useful lessons for Hong Kong’s Northern Metropolis. He highlighted the Metropolis’s goals of a university town, technology and industry, and a livable environment.

He then met Secretary of the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee Yin Li and Mayor Yin Yong, with Xu Qifang of the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office also present. Lee noted that Hong Kong is Beijing’s largest source of external investment and that the two places have long co-operated through the Hong Kong/Beijing Co-operation Conference.

He said the HKSAR’s First Five-Year Plan, announced in September, aligns with the national 15th Five-Year Plan. Lee will address the opening of the 29th Beijing-Hong Kong Economic Cooperation Symposium on Wednesday before travelling to Shanghai for the China International Import Expo.

zh.headline: 李家超展開北京訪問 晤尹力尹勇談北部都會區合作
zh.dek: 行政長官參觀北京城市副中心並與北京市委書記尹力及市長尹勇會面，討論十五五規劃下的合作。
body: 行政長官李家超周二展開北京訪問行程，先後參觀北京城市副中心，並與北京市領導會面。
李家超下午到訪副中心三大文化設施之一的北京圖書館，以及中共北京市委大樓內的規劃展覽廳，透過沙盤模型了解整體規劃及文化設施建設。
他表示，副中心作為京津冀協同發展的「兩翼」之一，其規劃及公共服務設施布局經驗，對香港推進北部都會區發展具參考價值。北部都會區目標包括大學城、科技產業及宜居宜業環境。
其後他與中共北京市委書記尹力及北京市長尹勇會面，中央港澳工作辦公室副主任徐啟方亦出席。李家超指香港是北京最大外來投資來源，雙方透過香港/北京合作會議機制長期合作。
他說特區政府九月公布的首份五年規劃，旨在主動對接國家十五五規劃。李家超將於周三出席第二十九屆京港經濟合作研討洽談會開幕禮並致辭，其後前往上海出席中國國際進口博覽會。
